title: Schema identifiers and schema versions
description: Grammar for canonical schema identity and version values. A schema identifier is a repository-controlled URN of the form urn:japp:schema:<segment>[:<segment>…]:v<major>; segments are lowercase kebab-case and the final segment pins the major version. A schema version is a strict MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH numeric triple with no prerelease or build metadata. The declared major of an instance must match a catalog schema's major exactly; minors are additive-only (see packages/contracts/README.md for the full compatibility policy).

schemaId.title: Canonical schema identifier
schemaId.description: Repository-controlled URN naming one schema document and its major version.

schemaVersion.title: Schema version triple
schemaVersion.description: Strict MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with no leading zeros, prerelease tags, or build metadata.
